test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In November 2022, Technology Transfer Scheme is implemented by which of these states?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Technology Transfer Scheme** was implemented by the state of **Kerala **in **November 2022**.
 
• The **government will reimburse companies up to 10 lakh **under the Technology Transfer Scheme**,** run by **Kerala Startup Mission (KSUM)**, **for technologies they acquire from government research institutions or source themselves and use to create potentially marketable items**.
 
• With the aid of this programme, **startups of Kerala** will have easier access to the knowledge needed to **transform their concepts into goods that can be sold**.
 
• Startups that are **registered as Limited Liability Partnerships (LLP) or Private Limited companies in Kerala** and have an **active registration with the Kerala Startup Mission (KSUM) **are eligible for the technology transfer scheme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Transfer of Technology (ToT) or technology transfer** is the** transfer of data **such as designs, inventions, materials, software, trade secrets, and technical know-how **from one organisation to another or from one use to another**.
 
• The **rules, practises, and principles of any organisation taking part in the technology transfer process serve as guidelines**.
 
• In order to share skills, knowledge, technologies, production techniques, and other things, universities, businesses, and governments can engage in **formal or informal technology transfer**. 
 
• This method of knowledge sharing **ensures that scientific and technological advancements are accessible to more user**s, who can then contribute to their growth or utilisation.
 
• Technology transfer can t**ake place vertically by shifting technologies or horizontally by moving technologies **between various regions.
